title_or_table: Housing Vacancies and Homeownership (CPS/HVS), Annual Statistics: 2025, Table 22. Homeownership Rates by Race and Ethnicity of Householder: 1994 to 2025
table_id: HVS Annual Statistics 2025, Table 22 (ann25t_22); margins of error from Table B-7 (ann25t_b7)
universe_or_base: Households, by the race and Hispanic origin of the householder. HVS definitions: the homeownership rate is computed by dividing the number of households that are owners by the total number of households. all_households is the U.S. total; non_hispanic_white, black and hispanic are householder groups (Hispanic of any race)
unit: rate_pct is owner households as a percent of all households in the group; moe_pct is the 90 percent margin of error (2025 only)
vintage: Table dated March 24, 2026 in its source note
qualification: Race categories changed in 2003 (race alone from 2003; earlier groups followed the older standard, with 'other' responses allocated from 1996 to 2002), so the Black and non-Hispanic White lines break at 2003. The 2025 annual figure leaves out October 2025, when no data were collected

columns.moe_pct: 90 percent margin of error (2025 only, from Table B-7)
columns.series_variant: 2002 has two values: original and revised_2000_census

v7_comparison: Atlas V7 cites second-quarter 2026 rates (74.5% non-Hispanic White, 45.4% Black, 48.1% Hispanic). This annual table ends in 2025; see the quarterly file for the check
unconfirmed: Margins of error for years before 2025 are in earlier annual releases and were not collected
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey/Housing Vacancy Survey, Annual Statistics 2025, Table 22, homeownership rate by race and ethnicity of householder, 1994 to 2025, United States. Retrieved November 6, 2026. Race categories changed in 2003; the 2025 average leaves out October, when no data were collected.
